description: This file defines the class FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategy, implementing a specific entitlement consumption strategy for leave management in the OrangeHRM system. It contains methods for handling leave creation, cancellation, period changes, and entitlement limits, utilizing various services and data access objects.

classes.name: FIFOEntitlementConsumptionStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class implementing FIFO (First-In, First-Out) logic for consuming leave entitlements, managing leave creation, cancellation, and period adjustments within the HRM system.

methods.name: getDao
methods.description: Retrieves the DAO object for entitlement consumption operations, initializing it if not already set.

methods.name: handleLeaveCreate
methods.description: Handles leave creation, allocating entitlements based on FIFO logic, and returning current and changed entitlement details.

methods.name: handleEntitlementStatusChange
methods.description: Placeholder for handling entitlement status changes (not yet implemented).

methods.name: handleLeaveCancel
methods.description: Handles the cancellation of a leave, adjusting entitlements and recapturing used days accordingly.

methods.name: handleLeavePeriodChange
methods.description: Handles updates to leave periods, such as start date changes, by delegating to DAO methods.

methods.name: getLeaveWithoutEntitlementDateLimitsForLeaveBalance
methods.description: Computes date limits for leave balances where no entitlements are present, based on current leave periods.

methods.name: getLeavePeriod
methods.description: Retrieve the current leave period for a given date.
